exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set the bench to a moderate incline, not fully upright.
Lower the dumbbells to the upper chest with elbows at 45 degrees.
Press up without locking out or flaring the elbows wide.
exercises.note: Focus on the clavicular portion of the chest.

exercises.name: Flat Bench Press (Machine or Barbell)
instructions: Plant feet and keep the upper back tight against the pad.
Lower the bar to mid-chest, not the neck.
Drive up in a slight arc without bouncing off the chest.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover (High Pulley)
instructions: Step forward so cables stay under tension at the start.
Keep a soft elbow and sweep the hands together at chest height.
Squeeze the chest at the midline, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Military Dumbbell Press
instructions: Brace the core and keep ribs down as you press.
Press the bells up and slightly in, not behind the head.
Lower to ear height without over-arching the lower back.

exercises.name: Inclined Lateral Raise
instructions: Lean the torso forward to about 70 degrees and stay there.
Raise the bells out to the sides with a slight elbow bend.
Stop at shoulder height and lower under control.
exercises.note: Lean body at 70° for greater initial tension.

exercises.name: Skull Crushers (EZ Bar)
instructions: Keep upper arms still and pointing toward the ceiling.
Bend only at the elbows to lower the bar toward the forehead.
Extend fully without letting the elbows flare out.

exercises.name: Rope Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Pin the elbows to your sides and keep them there.
Push the rope down and spread the ends at the bottom.
Return until the forearms are just above parallel.
exercises.note: Dropset on the last set to failure.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit tall and pull the bar to the upper chest, not behind the neck.
Drive the elbows down and in as the chest lifts toward the bar.
Control the stretch at the top without shrugging.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hinge at the hips until the torso is near parallel.
Pull the bar to the lower ribs with elbows close to the body.
Keep a neutral spine and do not jerk the weight up.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Brace on the bench and keep the working-side hip still.
Pull the bell to the hip, not the shoulder.
Lower until you feel a stretch without rotating the torso.

exercises.name: Face Pull (Wide Grip)
instructions: Set the pulley at face height and take a wide rope grip.
Pull toward the face while externally rotating the shoulders.
Lead with the elbows and squeeze the rear delts at the end.
exercises.note: Focus on rear deltoid and rhomboids.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand tall with elbows pinned at the sides.
Curl the bar up without swinging the torso.
Lower all the way; do not cut the range short.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Keep the palms facing each other throughout.
Curl without letting the elbows travel forward.
Squeeze at the top, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Shoulder Shrug
instructions: Hold the weight at the sides with arms straight.
Lift the shoulders straight up toward the ears.
Pause briefly, then lower without rolling the shoulders.

exercises.name: Squat (Free or Hack)
instructions: Brace the core and sit the hips down between the heels.
Keep the knees tracking over the toes.
Drive up through the mid-foot without rounding the back.
exercises.note: Hack squat preferred if lower back discomfort.

exercises.name: Leg Press 45°
instructions: Place feet high on the platform, about shoulder-width.
Lower until the knees are near 90 degrees without the lower back tucking.
Press through the heels and stop short of locking the knees.
exercises.note: Position feet high for greater glute focus.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Set the bar over the hips and plant the feet under the knees.
Drive the hips up until the torso and thighs form a straight line.
Squeeze the glutes at the top without over-arching the back.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
instructions: Adjust the pad so it sits on the lower shins, not the feet.
Extend until the legs are straight without jerking.
Lower slowly and keep the hips glued to the seat.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Line the knee joint with the machine's pivot.
Curl the pad down until the hamstrings fully shorten.
Do not lift the hips off the seat to cheat the last reps.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Let the heels drop for a full stretch at the bottom.
Rise onto the balls of the feet without bouncing.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
